log_dir.description: Directory containing raw Squid-style access logs to analyze.

report_dir.description: Directory where generated HTML reports and cached data will be stored.

base_url.description: Public-facing base URL for the web report interface (e.g., http://server.example.com/lightsquid).

timezone.description: PHP-compatible timezone string for time-based reports (e.g., 'America/New_York').

lang.description: Language code for report UI and titles; must match a locale file in 'lang/' directory.

user_detail.description: Enable detailed per-user breakdown in reports (e.g., hits, bytes, time ranges).

url_detail.description: Enable detailed per-URL (path-level) breakdown (may increase report size).

user_bandwidth.description: Enable per-user bandwidth summary (in MB) in reports.

time_report.description: Enable time-based reports: daily, weekly, monthly averages and trends.

max_days.description: Maximum number of days of historical per-day report data to retain; 0 = keep all.

log_format.description: Format of input log files: 'squid' (default), 'apache', 'combined', or 'custom'.

custom_log_format.description: Custom log format string (only used when log_format=custom). Must match Squid/HTTP log tokens.

access_log_path.description: Explicit path to access log file(s); supports wildcards (e.g., '/var/log/squid/access.log*'). Leave empty for auto-discovery under log_dir.

ignore_errors.description: If true, skip malformed log lines instead of stopping the parser.

db_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for database lock (SQLite/MySQL).

syslog.description: Log internal messages to syslog in addition to stderr.

db_path.description: Path to SQLite database file (used only if db_type=sqlite).

db_password.description: Database password (used only if db_type=mysql). Leave empty for no password.

web_enable.description: Enable built-in simple HTTP server for report access (use only for local dev or testing).

web_bind_ip.description: IP address to bind the built-in web server to (0.0.0.0 for all interfaces).

web_port.description: TCP port for the built-in web server.

web_root.description: Path to Lightsquid's web asset directory (HTML, CSS, images). Usually auto-detected.

web_auth_enabled.description: Enable HTTP basic authentication for the built-in web server.

web_htpasswd_file.description: Path to htpasswd file for basic auth credentials (only used if web_auth_enabled=true).

plugins.description: List of plugin names to enable (e.g., 'top_user', 'top_site').

name.description: Plugin name (must match a plugin directory under 'plugin/').

options.description: Key-value config options for this plugin. Each plugin defines its own options.

plugins_config.description: Per-plugin configuration objects. Each entry defines a plugin name and its options.
